reason: Story 5-2-export-csv spec is internally inconsistent: AC-1 requires the export to stream rows incrementally (no full buffering, memory ceiling 50MB) while AC-4 requires the export to be sorted by created_at ascending across the entire result set. A streaming export cannot guarantee a global sort without buffering. Additionally the spec's 'Implementation notes' section references an upstream `paginated_query()` helper that does not exist in src/db/ (grep returned zero hits). Quick-dev cannot proceed — the spec needs an operator amend to reconcile AC-1 vs AC-4 (drop streaming OR drop global sort OR add explicit pre-sort step) and to either add the missing helper or revise the implementation note.
